purpose: 24 original modular terrain-edge variants, uniformly scaled cached static drawing; source PNG alpha preserved

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent modular 2D platformer terrain-edge atlas, original game assets.
Primary request: four distinct very long thin horizontal dry mine slate and layered blue-grey shale strips for a dark hand-painted cavern exploration game.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024 PNG, strict ONE column by FOUR equal 256px-high rows. ONE separate horizontal strip in each row, from x=32 to x=1504. Each strip has its walkable upper edge on exactly y=64 within its row, and a naturally chipped underside ending around y=194. Keep clear transparent margins all around and between rows. Each upper edge must be continuous, nearly horizontal, with only 2-3 pixels of tiny weathering. Front orthographic side elevation, no perspective, no visible deep top surface. All four strips have compatible thickness and scale. Full-width nearly rectangular body, with chipped natural endcaps and irregular lower silhouette. No big triangular stalactites, no big foliage above the top, no floating objects.
Rows top to bottom: 1 fine fractured shale layers with root threads; 2 cracked heavier dark slate; 3 weathered stone with a narrow muted moss lip; 4 stratified rough mine rock with a few rust mineral streaks.
Style: detailed painterly realistic materials at side-scrolling game scale, readable small surface facets, soft neutral upper-left light. Palette: desaturated blue-grey, charcoal, muted earthy olive.
Constraints: genuine alpha-transparent background, no checkerboard painted into image, no backdrop, no ground or cast shadow outside object. No text, labels, numbers, UI, characters, watermark. All strips completely visible, not touching each other or the image edges.
